_owner: Matthew. FIXED FACTS: Remy must never contradict these. Values from USDA safe minimum internal temperatures + UK Food Standards Agency guidance. Re-verify before any public launch.
_rule: Remy cannot see inside food. For meat, fish and eggs always say: check with a thermometer in the thickest part.

poultry (chicken, turkey, duck), whole o.note: UK FSA: steaming hot, 70°C for 2 min or 75°C for 30s; no pink, juices run clear

minced meat (beef, pork, lamb burgers, s.note: Burgers and sausages must be cooked through, no pink

whole cuts of beef, lamb, veal (steaks,.note: Rest 3 minutes. Whole steaks can be served rare if the outside is properly seared; tell the cook it's their choice

reheated leftovers.note: Steaming hot all the way through; only reheat once

hazards.smoking_oil: Oil smoking heavily is close to catching fire. Take the pan off the heat. Never use water on an oil fire; cover it with a lid or fire blanket and turn off the heat.
hazards.cross_contamination: Raw meat must not touch ready-to-eat food. Separate boards or wash between, and wash hands after handling raw meat.
hazards.knife: Fingertips tucked into a 'claw' grip; knife moving away from the body.
